summary: Bulungu territory (Kwilu), part 1, covers Bulungu town and the Bulungu and Vanga areas along the Kwilu river (Bulungu, Vanga, Djuma and Lusanga health zones). No armed group is reported to control or regularly raid any locality here; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, western Bagata, Kenge) lies to the west. All locations are assessed as under ordinary state authority with the PNC as the main permanent force and customary chiefs operating under it. Live web research was unavailable for this run (search budget exhausted, news sites blocked), so confidence is medium for the two main towns and low elsewhere.

zones.description: Bulungu town, territorial seat on the Kwilu river (Bulungu health zone, CBCO Bulungu area)
zones.evidence: Territorial seat with territorial administration, PNC commissariat and courts; no armed group reported controlling the town. The Mobondo militia is active further west (Kwamouth, Bagata) and not reported in Bulungu. Web research was unavailable for this run.

zones.description: Vanga Victoire (Vanga mission/hospital town, Vanga health zone seat) on the Kwilu
zones.evidence: Mission and hospital town and secteur seat with PNC post; no armed-group activity reported. Mobondo violence affects territories to the west (Bagata, Kwamouth) but is not reported in Vanga. Web research was unavailable for this run.

zones.description: Bulungu secteur villages and towns around Bulungu town (Bulungu, Djuma and Lusanga health zones: Kintambu, Nkara, Ekubi, Longo, Niadi, Tebetebe, Mayala, etc.)
zones.evidence: No source reports armed-group activity in this area as of the reference date; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, Bagata, Kenge) lies to the west/south-west across the Kwilu/Kwango. Assessment rests on default state presence (PNC posts at secteur/groupement level, customary chiefs under state authority); live web research was unavailable for this run.

zones.description: Vanga secteur villages toward the Bagata/Masi-Manimba borders (Vanga and Djuma health zones: Zaba, Mbelo, Belemiese, Miheta, Nganga, Kingala, Kilusu, Mupoy, etc.)
zones.evidence: No source reports armed-group activity in this area as of the reference date; the Mobondo militia theatre (Kwamouth, Bagata, Kenge) lies to the west/south-west across the Kwilu/Kwango. Assessment rests on default state presence (PNC posts at secteur/groupement level, customary chiefs under state authority); live web research was unavailable for this run. This zone is the closest part of the unit to Bagata territory, where Mobondo holdouts were still reported raiding in 2026, so incursions cannot be excluded.
